findings.title: search_files symlink traversal
findings.notes: search_files follows an in-workspace symlink outside jupyter_root_dir: safe_jupyter_path validated only the search root, glob matches were opened directly. Re-authored the fix from closed PR #26 into a clean branch based on upstream plmbr/notebook-intelligence@d9f76a5, authored as maintainer, single commit 'fix(built-in-tools): confine search_files glob matches to workspace' + tests/test_builtin_search_files_sandbox.py (both isolated tests pass). Pushed to fork origin as security/fix-search-files-symlink-20260704031032-3406. Cross-fork PR into upstream DENIED (session GitHub scope is fork-only, App not installed on upstream) — open manually via the compare URL. Fork-only-file guard passed; git log author verified Herik Webb.

findings.title: PR review workflow vulnerable to prompt injection via diff content
findings.notes: LLM prompt embeds PR diff without injection-resistant framing; unvalidated output posted as PR comment. Fix: untrusted-content delimiters, system instruction hardening, comment disclaimer.

findings.title: list_files enumerates host files through workspace symlinks
findings.notes: list_files uses Path.glob() which follows symlinks without resolving matches against workspace root. Same class as #13 (search_files) but in a different function not covered by PR #26. Fix: resolve each glob match and reject outside workspace. PR #31 was closed without merging by maintainer.
